notes: Delete of technology-replace-0011's original property (asymmetry). The instances are rephrased around it ('Does it follow that stanford.edu is not a subdomain of cs.stanford.edu?', yes before), which can no longer be concluded. The direct question names two different domain names: RFC 1034's test for the relation (the subdomain's name ends with the containing domain's name) also holds of a name and itself, so a bare 'Is the relation asymmetric?' could be read as no (antisymmetric rather than asymmetric); between different names the reverse never holds, which is the property the edit removes.
